name: lcry_bar_gauge
description: 1px-wide LCRY strip in a BRCK slot: a vertical level/status gauge.
why: Console gauge pattern (build-lessons 'control console pattern', '#L#' columns): a single LCRY column sandwiched between two BRCK strips reads as a bar-graph pixel column; light it in sections with PSCN taps to show a level.
source: save2, x176-236 y68-140 (repeated bar columns behind the console)
